Help us build the future of digital marketing security.

Spikerz is growing, and we’re looking for people who want to help brands protect the digital channels they rely on every day.

See open roles

Why join Spikerz?

Be part of a fast-growing startup

Join a company building in one of the most important and underprotected areas of digital marketing, cybersecurity, and AI.

Real ownership and growth opportunities

Work on meaningful projects, take responsibility early, and see the direct impact of your work on the product, customers, and team. As Spikerz grows, you’ll have room to grow with it, professionally, personally, and creatively.

A tight-knit team

Work closely with people across product, R&D, marketing, sales, customer success, and leadership.

A central Tel Aviv office

Our office is in the heart of Sarona, close to great food, coffee, transport, and everything that makes the area one of Tel Aviv’s best places to work.

Daily perks

Enjoy Cibus, office snacks, team lunches, company events, and the small things that make the workday better.

A mission that matters

Help brands protect their accounts, communities, campaigns, and reputations from real threats.

Our values

Own the outcome

We look for people who take responsibility, move things forward, and care about the result.

Stay close to the customer

We build for real marketing and security teams, so we listen, learn, and solve practical problems.

Move fast, but think clearly

Speed matters, but so does judgment. We value people who can act quickly without losing focus.

Build trust

Trust is central to our product and our team. We communicate openly, follow through, and treat people with respect.

Keep learning

The world of marketing, security, and AI changes quickly. We look for people who stay curious and keep improving.
